name: Hierarchical Sparse Voxel Format (glTF-based)
definition: A hierarchical sparse voxel data format that divides a single voxel object into volumes and primitives (chunks) to handle sparsity, modeled after glTF's mesh/primitive structure.
summary: Hierarchical Sparse Voxel Format is a glTF-based data structure that organizes sparse 3D voxels into a hierarchy of volumes and primitives for efficient storage, unlike flat array formats.
